code.originalText: Lipid review nine weeks after adding ezetimibe

text.paragraph: Lipid review nine weeks after adding ezetimibe. [S]

Mr. Eisenhower returns for his lipid review. He has been back at full-time work for seven weeks, including two trips by air, without chest pain, breathlessness, or undue fatigue. He walks 40 minutes on most days and has started hitting golf balls at the practice range. He has had no muscle aches on atorvastatin and ezetimibe, and his home blood pressure averages 122/76. [S]
